_doc: Canonical v4 plate table (PLAN-V4.md §C7 is generated from this by app/scripts/plan-table.ts). nov: R|1|2. A 2 keeps >=4 of W/G/C/L/S vs the previous plate (or vs ref). A 1 changes >=4 and names a residue. Ground classes: dark|mid|light = what the pixel lint measures at the cut.

plates.W: night street, the hardware wall, photographed on film
plates.L: hardware centre-right, lyric as signage on it
plates.S: the orange point writes the line on the brick
plates.note: reference; the wall already holds the dark CRT cart, tubes and sign that p02–p07 light up one at a time

plates.S: the scope CRT on the cart lights up: the heart trace (physical, no graticule)
the TV wall; one dark tube hides the future
the neon script sign; one pink tube = the dream (pink is a token of the NIGHT palette family, G unchanged)
the LED ribbon running as a wave
bent neon tubes on the brick

plates.G: = (the clock face mustard is a subject accent; measured ground dark)
plates.S: the paper clock pasted on the brick

plates.W: = (same street, same film medium; only the exposure flips)
plates.S: = the clock wall at dawn (headlight trails are how the line is written, not a new subject)
the flip-board ticker on the street (years overtaken)
the room behind the shop window, swept by light; two figures
two irises (the figures' eyes) across the wall
the two figures double-exposed into one orbit, collapsing to a point at the anchor

plates.W: space (plasma, photographic physicality for all of COSMOS)
plates.S: the first light: whiteout 65.120 → gold curls from the singular point
plates.residue: the point from p12's exit = the singular point at the anchor

plates.S: the cosmic-web knot; the gaps grow
the Sun ignites (SDO-style surface)

plates.W: = (same photographic space; no clay, no peach backdrop)
plates.S: Earth + Theia impact

plates.W: = (same photographic space; the ink-wash idea is dropped)
plates.S: the debris ring gathers into the Moon
the sea page: the first cell divides
plates.residue: the moon disc = the red paper sun at the anchor

plates.S: the land page (page turn)
virtual vs real
plates.residue: the paper's cream edge = the tear lip

plates.C: slow macro crawl along the seam
plates.L: seam centre, the iris-to-be at the anchor
plates.S: the steel hand
plates.residue: p20's tear line = the hatch seam

plates.L: = (the engraved iris sits at the anchor)
plates.S: the engraved iris swallows the words

plates.C: = (the same slow crawl, now along the limb; no push)
plates.S: = the disc (iris → Earth; city lights are how the line is written)
the departure board on the night side

plates.G: = (jamo on the limb glow, never white)
plates.S: the jamo scatter
the cage closes around the line

plates.G: light: dawn on the limb (colour field)
plates.S: = the cage, dissolving in the dawn
the city page
plates.note: callback: the paper world returns; compared against p19, exempt from the consecutive-2 pixel lint

plates.S: the marks merge back into the point; hit 142.035 = whiteout + cut-in (timed, inside the plate)
plates.note: callback; lyric line 28 starts 141.235 so the boundary cannot move

plates.W: white ridgelines on black (spatial, perspective rows)
plates.S: the heartbeat flattens
plates.residue: the point sits on the front ridge

plates.S: stones across the void
the sun; silhouettes reach
silhouettes around the fire; hit 165.343 = the fire ignites (whiteout, timed)
the clay tablet, a wedge per beat
panes light per beat
plates.residue: the tablet's window light = the first pane

plates.W: thermal LUT of the same window
plates.S: = the window (machine silhouettes — gears, a loco — pass behind the panes as the bar-4 deviation; the window stays the subject)

plates.G: light (measured at the cut); the last bar is the exit: night falls, the dither dots glow as a grid above the horizon, camera settles static
plates.S: whiteout + the cloud
the first computer (lamp grid → C64)
plates.residue: p37's exit dots = the lamp grid

plates.S: modem → network

plates.G: = dark (the face is bright on the dark ground; no full-frame flood, not a whiteout)
plates.S: data → face → eye
the sun and the swarm building its shell (volleys per beat)

plates.G: = dark (lit dancheong panels on a dark vault; no flood)
plates.S: = the shell, closing
= the sealed shell (the stars going dark is the beat action)
the title born from the disc

plates.L: = (vs ref p01; the signage slot stays empty — instrumental)
plates.S: the point dies per beat
